	<div id='main' class='all_colors' data-scroll-offset='116'>
	<div   class='main_color container_wrap_first container_wrap sidebar_right'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><main  role="main" itemprop="mainContentOfPage"  class='template-page content  av-content-small alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-9'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'><div  class='av-special-heading av-k9bf33ek-78bce5c260ea334b7fc0531f9a4be0f1 av-special-heading-h1 blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-0  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag'  itemprop="headline"  >Bahia Salinas Spot Info</h1><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-k8yruwpg-b620ef62fe8a6ee3da0c8adcfa7fca68 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p style="text-align: justify;">The Spot info, our kiteboarding school is located north west of Costa Rica at the province of Guanacaste, by the pacific Ocean, close to the border with Nicaragua. The closest international airport is Liberia, just 70Km away. Salinas Bay is the spot most windy to Central America.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Our Kiteboarding school in Costa Rica, is operates on Salinas bay beaches, normally Playa Copal. They are almost 2 km long<br />
There are no people or boats around you to worry about. It is not a crowded spot, you will never find more than 20 kiters in the water at the same time.<br />
The water is fairly flat.<br />
The wind is Side on Shore</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">This are the conditions for the next days:<br />
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://es.windfinder.com/widget/forecast/js/bahia_salinas_playa_copal?unit_wave=m&#038;unit_rain=mm&#038;unit_temperature=c&#038;unit_wind=kts&#038;columns=2&#038;days=2&#038;show_day=1&#038;show_pressure=0&#038;show_waves=0&#038;show_rain=0"></script><br />
<span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #000000;">There are consistent strong winds everyday from Nov to May as you can see in this graph from wind guru:</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-360" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/bahia_salinas_wind_stats.png" alt="Stats per year" width="612" height="250" /></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The weather is always warm and the water is warm most of the time. We provide wetsuits and booties during lessons in case you want it and also offer them for rent .</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #000000;">If you wanna bring your gear, the most popular kite size is 8m.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">One singularity about this spot is the island placed right in the middle of the bay called Bolaños island. It is an amazing natural spot with beautiful light sand and flat water.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">This is an amazing spot you will never regret to visit!!! Take lessons in kiteboarding school Costa Rica!!</p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;">Costa Rica Info</h2>
<p>Costa Rica is known as the Latin American Swiss, because of its natural beauty, mountains and views. It is one of the very few countries with no army (since 1948). According to the global peace index, Costa Rica is one of the safest countries in Latin America and where corruption is very low.</p>
<p>The closest town to the sport is La Cruz (5Km) with a population around 20.000.</p>
<p><span style="color: #000000;"> </span></p>
